title: App panel state
description: An app card's saved panel state: the file the board keeps for one card, `app-state/<card identity>.json` in the open ledger's folder, holding the version of this shape, the app the card named when its panel saved, and the value. `$defs/value` is what a panel may save; `$defs/save` the params of the panel's `vision-board/save-state` request and the body of `put_panel_state`; `$defs/saved` the panel's answer; `$defs/read` the answer of `get_panel_state`; `$defs/written` the answer of `put_panel_state`. No agent reads any of it.
$comment: D-050; docs/specification/apps.md § Saving the panel's state

v.description: The version of this file's shape (`APP_STATE_FORMAT`).

app.description: The app the card named when its panel saved. A card that now names another app gets no state.

value.description: Any JSON value the panel chose to save, so that when it starts again it carries on where it was. At most `APP_LIMITS.stateBytes` bytes as compact UTF-8 JSON: a schema can't count bytes, so `appStateProblem` checks that, and a bigger value is `too-large`.

save.description: Save this value for the card, in place of the one before.

saved.description: The panel's answer once the board holds the value: an empty object.

read.description: The card's saved value; `state` is left out when nothing is saved, or when the card now names another app.

written.description: The value is saved: its size in bytes of compact UTF-8 JSON.

bytes.description: The saved value's size; the most is `APP_LIMITS.stateBytes`.
